author: Samsung
description:
At The Apurva Kempinski Bali, the 5-star guest experience is shaped by thoughtful service, elegant design and technology that fits naturally into every moment. With Samsung Hospitality TV and LYNK Cloud, that same attention to detail continues on screen.

In guest rooms, Samsung Hospitality TV gives guests convenient access to hotel information, dining and in-room entertainment, along with seamless streaming through Google Cast.

For hotel teams, Samsung LYNK Cloud provides centralized control of in-room TVs, guest-facing content and digital services across the property, while built-in business intelligence offers insight into guest preferences to help improve service and support revenue opportunities.

Discover more at http://smsng.co/yt_B2Bsolutions
